review: DAENEM Staff Portal Widget governance boundary review

findings.summary: An authorized sign-in settings caller could submit and persist an unbounded widget-instance array, creating avoidable configuration-size and rendering pressure.
findings.correction: Backend and shared client normalization now cap sign-in widget instances at 20 before validation, storage or rendering.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Widget governance change; authenticated V45 browser acceptance remains pending and the generic Report Builder remains blocked by the absent durable contract.
